scheme_name: Civil Services Incentive Scheme for Persons with Disabilities
other_conditions: Applicant must have a disability of 40% or more as defined under the Persons with Disabilities Act, 1995.
Candidate must be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
Eligibility is limited to candidates who pass any stage (preliminary, main, or final) of the Civil Services Examination conducted by UPSC or MPPSC.
Application form must be submitted within 6 months of the examination result declaration.
Incentive amount is provided only once per candidate at each stage of the examination.
benefits_summary: Financial incentives of ₹20,000 for the preliminary exam, ₹30,000 for the main exam, and ₹20,000 for final selection, transferred directly to the applicant's bank account.
